Backend architecture (DDD +
hexagonal)
backend/core/
— the domain. Bounded contexts:
gpu_offering
,
reservation_request
,
hosting_provider
,
geographical_region
,
gpu_model
,
organization
,
user
,
allocation
,
access_request
,
provider_onboarding
,
feedback
,
audit
,
authorization
,
partner_domain
,
salesforce
. Ports (interfaces)
and domain services live here;
kernels/
holds shared ids,
enums and errors.
backend/infrastructure/driving/http/
— the driving
adapter: FastAPI app factory (
main.py
), routers, auth
middleware, request schemas, rate limiting.
backend/infrastructure/driven/
— driven adapters:
SQLAlchemy database models and repositories with Alembic migrations,
email, Keycloak admin, Temporal clients, Salesforce, feedback.
The domain never imports infrastructure; adapters implement the core
ports.
Division of
labour between backend and worker
The
backend owns all domain changes
(status
transitions, imports, emails rendering).
The
worker owns time
: timers, schedules, retries,
fan-out. Its activities call back into backend System APIs using a
Keycloak service account (
workflow-worker
client) with
scopes
notification:send
,
capacity:sync
,
reservation-request:write
.
Data stores
PostgreSQL
(Cloud SQL in GCP) — application data,
Keycloak data, analytics views (
analytics
schema for
Superset), audit log (purged after about 13 months).
Redis
(Memorystore) — rate limiting buckets
(default, mutate, auth, import, availability, feedback), optional cache,
role-sync budgets.
Temporal
— workflow state (Temporal Cloud in shared
environments, local Temporal in Docker for development).
Frontend architecture
Next.js 15 App Router (
frontend/src/app/**/page.tsx
),
React 19, Ant Design 6, Tailwind CSS 4, Roboto font.
Authentication with NextAuth 5 + Keycloak; middleware
(
frontend/src/middleware.ts
,
frontend/src/services/auth/config.ts
) protects
/customer
and
/provider
routes and enforces
status gates and scopes.
State: Zustand stores (marketplace, inventory, What’s New) and SWR
for server data; Axios for backend calls
(
frontend/src/services/backend/*.ts
).
Maps and charts with D3 and topojson; react-markdown for the in-app
User Manual (
frontend/src/content/USER_MANUAL.md
).
What’s New content lives in
frontend/src/content/whats-new.json
.
UI rules:
frontend/UI_STANDARDS.md
(page headers,
filters, chips, Title Case buttons, WCAG 2.2 AA).
Cloud platform
Private
GKE Autopilot
clusters on Google Cloud,
Cloud SQL PostgreSQL, Memorystore Redis, Secret Manager, regional
Gateway load balancing, Cloud Armor, network policies. Temporal Cloud
for orchestration. Terraform owns cloud resources; Helm owns workloads;
GitLab CI builds and promotes immutable images.
